purpose: Loading 加载; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandLoading](../../lib/src/components/loading.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Host owns work/activity. Loading owns delay, one opaque surface, snow, local focus scope and cancellation. Entry200ms and configured exit affect decoration only. Necessary tip/backing stay opaque; background pointer, focus traversal and semantics remain unavailable until removal. Reactivation cancels removal without remounting tip; reduced motion stabilizes entry or completes exit immediately. Disposal cancels all owned resources.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. Modal Tab traversal consumes forward and reverse keys even when a closed loop keeps the same target or contains no actions. One shared boundary in the existing action module delegates order to the existing FocusScope, owns one skipped non-semantic target for an otherwise empty scope, and removes its borrowed-scope listener and owned node on disposal. It does not inspect children, add another FocusScope or replace a caller-owned focus target. IslandDialogRoute now defaults explicitly to TraversalEdgeBehavior.closedLoop; an explicitly supplied non-closed-loop policy, including null inheritance from Navigator, remains authoritative. Drawer, Loading, showIslandModal and the shared preview/alert route consume this same behavior. Actual Web keyboard and Windows/AT validation remain separate from widget tests.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Reversed decorative transitions shorten by remaining distance. A separate fadeDuration timer owns removal and is cancelled by reactivation; snow continues through interruptions. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: Necessary content on its actual supporting surface, including reduced-motion changes
scenarios.when: Enter, sample intermediate frames, reverse/reopen, close, cancel and unmount
scenarios.then: Content/backing remain paired and readable; one content subtree retains state; hit/focus/semantics track availability; no stale timer or duplicate callback. Approved reference deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md.

scenarios.given: The component-owned modal boundary, or its registered Gallery alert callback, with zero/one/multiple actions
scenarios.when: Forward/reverse Tab, activation, dismissal, rejected close or owner removal occurs
scenarios.then: Closed loops consume Tab without leaving the modal; callbacks fire once and accepted close restores origin. Explicit route traversal overrides survive, opaque child identity/styles remain, and owned focus resources are cleaned up.
